factors.label: Usage declining
factors.detail: Login activity is well below your most active accounts.

factors.label: Unresolved support tickets
factors.detail: 3 of 4 tickets are open or reopened.

recommendations.title: Resolve open support issues
recommendations.reasoning: A spike in tickets is a leading churn signal. Closing them removes the most immediate source of frustration.
steps: Assign one named owner to this account and consolidate every open issue into a single thread.
Give the customer a written summary of what is being fixed and by when.
Review the ticket themes for a root cause and fix it so the volume does not return.

recommendations.title: Provide additional onboarding & training
recommendations.reasoning: Login activity is well below your healthiest accounts — hands-on training re-establishes the habit that drives retention.
steps: Book a 20-minute guided session focused on the one outcome they signed up for.
Set up or complete one thing for them live so they leave with a result.
Check usage weekly for a month and intervene again if it stays flat.

recommendations.title: Clear the open ticket backlog
recommendations.reasoning: Open and reopened tickets are the top churn driver here — resolving them rebuilds confidence fast.
steps: Resolve or formally answer every open ticket on this account today, oldest first.
Send one recap message confirming each item is closed and what changed.
Follow up 7 days later to confirm nothing reopened.
